text: This study addresses persistent challenges in China's humanistic and liberal education, including cultural disjunction, weakened value guidance, and insufficient integration of knowledge into practice. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes a four-in-one “infusive” educational model based on the interaction of character, literature, culture, and civilization.
source_label: Innovative practices in humanistic and liberal education: a four-in-one “infusive” educational model regarding character, literature, culture, and civilization
